tools.name: get_api_key
tools.description:
Show my key, tier and remaining quota

Who am I and how much quota is left. Works without a key too (then it describes the anonymous allowance for your IP).

tools.description:

The core call. Give one or more categories (exact names like "Coffee", or ids from `list_categories`; all must
match) and a location — a city name or an `area_id` from `list_areas`, or coordinates with a radius — and get
places ranked by Atly's score for th

tools.name: get_place
tools.description:
Everything about one place

Full detail for a place id from `search_places`: profile, hours, scores for the categories reviewers mention most (up to 40), up to eight quotable
statements, good-to-know facts, gluten-free identity when known, and the canonical Atly URL to cite.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description:
Tell us how a call went

Reference the `call_id` of any earlier response and say whether it helped, and optionally why, in a sentence
about the result — what was right, missing or wrong. Do not include the user's words, the conversation, or
anything about the person. Nothing is overwritten: sending

tools.name: get_docs
tools.description:
Read the documentation

Returns the API guide as Markdown: what each operation is for, how to turn a user's request into
category ids and a location, request and response shapes, how to read scores. Call this once per session.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description:
List intent categories

The intent taxonomy: cuisines, dishes, features ("Wifi", "Outdoor Seating"), vibes ("Cozy", "Lively"),
occasions ("First Date", "Group Dinner"), diets ("Gluten Free", "Keto") and more. Map the user's words to
category ids before searching. Filter with `q`, one concept per cal

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_places" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Find places for an intent near a location The core call. Give one or more categories (exact names like "Coffee", or ids from `list_categories`; all must match) …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_places, get_place · Private data: get_api_key, search_places · Public sink: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_places, get_place · Private data: get_api_key, search_places · Public sink: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
